description: This file defines the schema for the HdmiCecSink API, including method signatures, parameters, results, events, and related metadata. It is used for generating or validating API interfaces for managing HDMI CEC sink devices in a software project.

methods.name: getActiveRoute
methods.description: Gets details for the current route from the source to sink devices. Used for debugging the route.

methods.name: getActiveSource
methods.description: Gets details for the current active source.

methods.name: getAudioDeviceConnectedStatus
methods.description: Get status of audio device connection.

methods.name: getDeviceList
methods.description: Gets the number of connected source devices and system information for each device.

methods.name: getEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether HDMI-CEC is enabled on platform.

methods.name: getOSDName
methods.description: Returns the OSD name used by host device.

methods.name: getVendorId
methods.description: Gets the current vendor ID used by host device.

methods.name: printDeviceList
methods.description: Prints the list of connected devices and properties for debugging.

methods.name: requestActiveSource
methods.description: Requests the active source in the network.

methods.name: requestShortAudioDescriptor
methods.description: Sends the CEC Request Short Audio Descriptor (SAD) message.

methods.name: sendAudioDevicePowerOnMessage
methods.description: Power on the connected audio device.

methods.name: sendGetAudioStatusMessage
methods.description: Request the audio status via CEC.

methods.name: sendKeyPressEvent
methods.description: Send a user control pressed message.

methods.name: sendUserControlPressed
methods.description: Send a user control pressed message.

methods.name: sendUserControlReleased
methods.description: Send a user control released message.

methods.name: sendStandbyMessage
methods.description: Send a standby message to the device.

methods.name: setActivePath
methods.description: Set the source device to active, waking it from standby if necessary.

methods.name: setActiveSource
methods.description: Set the current active source as TV (physical address 0.0.0.0).

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enable or disable HDMI-CEC support in the platform.

methods.name: setMenuLanguage
methods.description: Update menu language and broadcast a CEC message.

methods.name: setOSDName
methods.description: Set the OSD Name used by host device.

methods.name: setRoutingChange
methods.description: Change routing between HDMI inputs and TV.

methods.name: setupARCRouting
methods.description: Enable or disable ARC routing.

methods.name: setVendorId
methods.description: Set a vendor ID used by host device.

methods.name: setLatencyInfo
methods.description: Set current latency values for auto lip-sync.
